---
title: "Friend-shoring: what Biden wants to achieve by trading with allies rather than rivals"
description: "Mexico and Canada have overtaken China as America's top trading partners as Biden's friend-shoring strategy reshapes US trade — but the long-run payoff is uncertain."
date: "2024-03-20"
categories: [trade-wars]
---

The Biden administration's tilt toward trading with allies rather than
geopolitical rivals has already changed the map: Mexico and Canada have
overtaken China as the United States' largest trading partners. Friend-shoring
is presented as a new doctrine, but this piece places it in a much longer
tradition of trade policy used for political ends, from Cold War-era
sanctions to today's CHIPS Act — and cautions that the strategy carries real
economic trade-offs, with short-term competitive gains that may not translate
into lasting benefit.

**Originally published on The Conversation**, March 20, 2024.
